What Is Your Child Actually Doing on AI? The 37% Awareness Gap

Only 37% of parents whose teen used AI knew about it. How to find out what your child is doing, and start the conversation without a fight.

You discovered your child has been using AI for weeks. You had no idea. You are not failing as a parent, you are experiencing the largest documented gap in digital parenting today. Research shows only 37% of parents whose teen had actually used generative AI knew about it. Half of students used ChatGPT for school; only 26% of parents knew.

Most AI platforms offer no parental dashboard. Character.ai, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity were built for adults. The surveillance search, 'how do I see what my kid is saying to AI?', exists because the industry ignored families entirely.

Ask, don't audit first: 'What AI tools do you and your friends use? Show me your favourite one.' Curiosity lowers defensiveness.

Check browser history and home-screen apps together, frame it as safety, not punishment.

Set one family rule: no AI accounts or chats without telling a parent. Make it normal, like knowing each other's phone passwords for emergencies.

Enrol in structured environments where AI use is visible and guided, weekend programmes, holiday camps, and parent sessions where you see the workflow together.
